newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Renault Belgium workers to strike Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Renault Belgium workers to strike Tuesday.

text.p: Workers at the Renault plant in Vilvoorde, Belgium, plan a 24-hour strike on Tuesday in protest against plans to close the site, union leaders said on Monday.
"We wanted to give a fast reaction (to the French court ruling), therefore we are calling a 24-hour strike on Tuesday," Renault union leader Karel Gacoms told VTM television.
A French court of appeal ruled last week that the French car maker must call a meeting of its European works council representing employees before it can close Vilvoorde.
Renault had appealed against a previous ruling which said it had not followed the proper procedures in arriving at the controversial decision to close Vilvoorde on July 31.
The plant employs 3,100 staff and the February 27 closure news sparked protests by Belgian car workers.
The French Socialist Party has said it will push for a review of the decision to close the plant if it wins the May 25 parliamentary election.
The French government has a 46 percent stake in Renault.
